data.one_liner: Beautiful sparkline charts for Flutter with custom lines, points, and fill.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Sparkline widget to render compact charts for trend lines, high/low values, and averages. Supports features like cubic smoothing, gradients, grid lines, and animations.
use_when: You need to display simple, clean sparklines or trend lines inside your Flutter UI.
You want to highlight maximum, minimum, first, or last values easily.
You require custom fills, point markers, or gradients on a small data series.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-axis charts, bar charts, or pie charts.
You need gesture detection to select the closest point on tap, which is not implemented.
strengths: Supports custom fill and line gradients.
Includes built-in features for averages, grid lines, and min/max markers.
weaknesses: Lacks touch interaction to tap and inspect specific points on the sparkline.
Does not support multiple overlapping sparklines on a shared axis.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick fl_chart if you need fully interactive, feature-rich charts with gesture support and multiple chart types.
